subject: financial_literacy
concept: Evaluating a realistic want-purchase decision against a full financial picture (budget, savings goals, and opportunity cost)
source_inspiration: original content, connecting to the Discipline Pillar — not sourced from any external text

exercise.pictorial: Student weighs a want-purchase against its opportunity cost (what else that money could have grown into if invested instead)
exercise.abstract: Student explains a decision about a realistic purchase, weighing it against its true opportunity cost

misconception_flags: evaluates a purchase using only its sticker price, ignoring the opportunity cost of not saving or investing that money instead

interest_binding: scenario generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
